proposals.evidence: CDIAL 9723-12 Section 12 *māḍa explicitly gives Lahnda/Punjabi māṛā bad and WPah. maṛɔ weak/bad. These ā/a/ə-vowel flapped forms select that branch, with short-vowel *maḍḍa retained as a neighboring alternative in the article. Exact form maːɽə is preserved; possible intra-Indo-Aryan transmission remains open.
